description: Shows which Codex hooks are silently switched off and lets you allow them after seeing exactly what they run. Each new or changed hook lists its command, matcher, timeout and source file, with a field-by-field diff against the version you allowed. Allow is saved through Codex App Server on the machine running the thread and verified by Codex; Don't run is remembered until the hook changes. Agents are told hooks wait but cannot allow them. Requires BB 0.50.1+ and Codex CLI.
